WITH livonia_geometry AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Livonia'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'Indiana'
)
SELECT
  ST_ValueCount(
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast,
      lg.geom,
      TRUE
    ),
    1
  ) AS elevation_stats
FROM
  livonia_geometry lg,
  public.dem_us r
WHERE
  ST_Intersects(r.rast, lg.geom);
